SERVICE AGREEMENT

1. SERVICE DESCRIPTION
We provide consulting services to help businesses improve their operations.

2. PAYMENT TERMS
Payment is due within 30 days of invoice date. Late payments may incur a 5% fee.

3. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
Both parties agree to maintain the confidentiality of any proprietary information shared during the course of this agreement.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Our liability is limited to the amount paid for services in the 12 months preceding any claim.
